name: Tech & Imaging
description: A 15-episode series on the technology that powers modern optometry — OCT, visual fields, topography, and the interpretation skills every optometrist needs.

episodes.title: OCT Principles: Time-Domain vs Spectral-Domain vs Swept-Source
episodes.description: The physics of OCT, the resolution and speed evolution, and the clinical impact of each generation on the optometric practice.

episodes.title: OCT-Angiography: The Choriocapillaris, the CNV, and the Artifacts
episodes.description: The OCT-A principle (motion contrast), the clinical use in wet AMD and DR, and the projection and decorrelation artifacts to recognise.

episodes.title: Visual Field Testing: Strategy, Reliability, and the Glaucoma Progression Analysis
episodes.description: The SITA-Standard vs SITA-Fast, the reliability indices (fixation, false positive, false negative), and the GPA and the event and trend analysis.

episodes.title: Corneal Topography and Tomography: The Belin-Ambrosio and the Keratoconus Match
episodes.description: The axial, tangential, and refractive maps, the elevation and pachymetry maps, and the Belin-Ambrosio enhanced ectasia display.

episodes.title: Fundus Photography: The 45-Degree vs Wide-Field and the Image Quality
episodes.description: The 45-degree standard fields, the wide-field (Optos, Clarus) advantage, and the image quality and the artifact recognition.

episodes.title: Fundus Autofluorescence: The Lipofuscin Map and the Geographic Atrophy
episodes.description: The FAF principle (lipofuscin), the hypo- and hyper-autofluorescence patterns, and the monitoring of geographic atrophy and Stargardt.

episodes.title: Ultrasound Biomicroscopy: The Angle, the Ciliary Body, and the ICL Vault
episodes.description: The UBM principle (50 MHz), the angle and ciliary body imaging, and the use in ICL vault and tumour assessment.

episodes.title: B-Scan Ultrasonography: The Vitreous, the Retina, and the Tumour
episodes.description: The B-scan use when the fundus is obscured, the retinal detachment and tumour assessment, and the axial vs transverse vs longitudinal scan.

episodes.title: Electrodiagnostics: ERG, VEP, and EOG — When and What They Show
episodes.description: The full-field and multifocal ERG, the VEP in optic nerve disease, and the EOG in Best disease — the clinical indications and interpretation.

episodes.title: Pachymetry: Ultrasound vs Optical and the CCT in Glaucoma
episodes.description: The ultrasound vs optical pachymetry, the central corneal thickness effect on Goldmann IOP, and the OHTS finding on CCT and glaucoma risk.

episodes.title: Wavefront Aberrometry: The Zernike Coefficients and the Higher-Order Aberrations
episodes.description: The Hartmann-Shack principle, the Zernike pyramid, the higher-order aberrations (coma, spherical aberration), and the use in custom LASIK.

episodes.title: Tear Osmolarity and Inflammation Markers: The Diagnostic Tests for Dry Eye
episodes.description: The osmolarity cutoff and variability, the MMP-9 (InflaDry) test, and how these objective tests complement the clinical exam.

episodes.title: Meibography Systems: The Gland Dropout, Tortuosity, and the Patient Education
episodes.description: The meibography imaging systems (LipiScan, Keratograph), the grading of gland dropout, and the patient education visual.

episodes.title: Inflammation Markers: MMP-9 and the Point-of-Care Testing in Dry Eye
episodes.description: The point-of-care tests (InflaDry, osmolarity), the diagnostic algorithm, and the role in monitoring treatment response.

episodes.title: Artificial Intelligence in Eye Care: The FDA-Approved Systems and the Optometrist Role
episodes.description: The IDx-DR and EyeArt autonomous AI for diabetic retinopathy, the AI in OCT and glaucoma, and the optometrist's role in the AI era.
